name: MonarchAiGeneratedBadge
title: AiGeneratedBadge
wrapsNative: androidx.compose.foundation.layout.Row with background, border or a dashed drawBehind outline, and androidx.compose.material3.Text
summary: A small provenance badge that marks content as written by AI, written with AI help, or edited by a person after AI wrote it.
whenToUse: Next to text, a value or a document that AI produced or changed, so people know to check it.
whenNotToUse: For a status that is not about AI use MonarchBadge. For how sure the AI is use MonarchAiConfidenceMeter.
api: @Composable fun MonarchAiGeneratedBadge(modifier: Modifier = Modifier, kind: MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeKind = MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeKind.Generated, model: String? = null, dateMillis: Long? = null, size: MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeSize = MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeSize.Md, iconOnly: Boolean = false, icon: (@Composable () -> Unit)? = null, label: String? = null, detail: String? = null)
enum class MonarchAiGeneratedBadgeKind { Generated, Assisted, Edited }

options.name: model
options.description: The model that produced the content. Part of the provenance line; blank text counts as none.

options.name: dateMillis
options.description: When the content was produced, in epoch milliseconds (UTC). Part of the provenance line, as a medium date and short time in the device time zone.

options.name: size
options.description: Sm for table cells and dense lists, or Md.

options.name: iconOnly
options.description: Shows only the icon; TalkBack still reads the label. Ignored without an icon.

options.name: icon
options.description: The AI mark before the label. Monarch bundles no icons; it takes the strong AI color.

options.name: label
options.description: Replaces the built-in label of the kind.

states.name: icon only
states.description: A round badge with the icon alone.

states.name: with provenance
states.description: Looks the same; TalkBack reads the model and time after the label.

appearance: A capsule in the subtle AI fill with the AI border and the strong AI role for the icon and the text, in every theme. The edited kind has a dashed border.
platformNotes: It is not built on MonarchBadge, because that has no AI colors, no dashed border and no provenance; it uses the badge's type and weight so the two line up. The web shows the model and time in a tooltip on hover and focus; touch has no tooltip, so on Android they are read by TalkBack after the label and never shown, as on iOS. The web's tooltip prop takes arbitrary content; detail is a String. The web and iOS draw the AI bot glyph; Monarch for Android bundles no icons, so the glyph is the icon slot, and iconOnly without an icon shows the label. Both sizes use the caption type role, because Monarch has no smaller one; Sm has less padding and a smaller icon box. The date is epoch milliseconds, formatted with android.icu.text.DateFormat in the configuration locale.
accessibility: One TalkBack element whose content description is the label, then the provenance line when there is one.
The label is read for an icon-only badge too.
The edited kind differs by its dashed border and its text, not by color.
The icon is inside the cleared semantics, so it is never read on its own.
Not interactive, so it has no touch target. The text grows with the font size setting.
edgeCases: Without a model and a date there is no provenance line.
A long custom label wraps inside the capsule.
A blank model counts as no model.
iconOnly without an icon shows the label, because the badge would otherwise be empty.
